assets.name: espresso.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: final square product advertising photograph for a premium desktop ecommerce editorial gallery.
Primary request: a beautiful compact sculptural brushed stainless steel espresso machine with plausible unbranded simple controls. One ivory espresso cup directly beneath the grouphead. Entire machine and cup fully visible. The machine rests on a folded deep ultramarine-blue plinth resembling one wide sculptural ribbon, in a saturated cobalt seamless cyclorama. Gallery-grade product campaign from a world-class creative agency and conceptual design studio, sophisticated restrained surreal set design.
Composition: 1:1 square image, front three-quarter viewpoint, readable large hero product entirely inside central 80 percent square. Deliberate elegant negative space, product dominates but no tight cropping. Professional high-end still life product photography with believable precise manufacturing details.
Lighting: warm strong directional sunlight, crisp geometric shadows, subtle metal highlights and exquisite brushed steel texture, rich blue studio atmosphere. Physical light and shadow, refined editorial color.
Constraints: one espresso machine, one cup, one folded blue ribbon plinth. No people, text, brand names, logos, watermark, UI, typographic elements, collage, grids, borders, futuristic effects, neon, repeated pattern or repeated machines.
assets.qa: Viewed: plausible brushed steel machine and cup, cobalt folded-ribbon plinth, entire hero visible, no text/logo/UI.

Constraints: exactly one lamp, two large white curved architectural sculptural surfaces, sage background. No people, text, branding, logos, watermark, UI, typography, multiple products, grids, collage, repeated background, neon, space or sci-fi effects.
